attempts.hypothesis: one composite (route -> simplify -> seed -> coarsened-arm racing over span-gated cold V-cycles) dominates every specialist
attempts.causal_note: THREE CONFIRMED RECORDS in one run: reg3_1000 131.154 (expander family's first fall, -2.76), ksg 37.087, sycamore_53 60.104; first positive-mean scored run. Surfacecode confirmation coin-flip lost; dbn relabeling anomaly recorded

attempts.hypothesis: replica-exchange tempering escapes basins via state swaps down the ladder
attempts.causal_note: FALSIFIED at scale: swap acceptance -> 0% as per-node energy gaps grow with n; degenerates to M independent anneals at 1/M throughput. Mechanism real at n=250 (descent fingerprint). Also exposed eins-metadata bug in ExprTree conversion

attempts.hypothesis: consensus-backbone freezing re-anneals only the disagreement region
attempts.causal_note: FALSIFIED on claim: fires in a transient sweet spot (consensus 0.2-0.45, e.g. reg3 172.8->144.3) then pool collapses to full agreement; rqc touch 106.39 did not survive medians (106.83)

attempts.hypothesis: simplification unlocks MCTS/UCT lookahead on reduced networks
attempts.causal_note: MCTS FALSIFIED (depth 3 of ~380 at 8-25 rollouts/s) but its simplify-pipeline ablation set the SYCAMORE RECORD 59.911 with the campaign's tightest medians — third independent replication of the simplify mechanism

attempts.hypothesis: late-acceptance hill climbing replaces the temperature schedule
attempts.causal_note: FALSIFIED in SA's favor: LAHC never cools on plateau-dominated landscapes (acceptance pinned 0.93-0.99); explicit linear schedules are load-bearing; DLAS > LAHC but < SA

attempts.hypothesis: dropping the coarsener and spending the freed budget on basin-hopping cycles beats 034
attempts.causal_note: Partial locally (reg3_1000 132.78 signal) but 047 absorbed and exceeded it (131.15); corrected 034's attribution — warm coarse anneal is load-bearing, coarsener wins as a racing-arm seed, not standalone

attempts.hypothesis: bounded cheap-first VE peel scales the hyperedge mechanism to large label sets
attempts.causal_note: FALSIFIED with mechanism boundary: peel is fast (22-260ms at 4086 labels) but freezing the periphery/core split destroys interleaved optima — VE is intrinsically small-hypergraph

reflection.review: Composite + innovation cycle. 047 took three records in one run including reg3_1000 (first expander fall in 53 attempts) and produced the first positive-mean scored run; 050's ablation pushed the real-Sycamore record to 59.911 (third simplify replication). Five falsifications with structural mechanism boundaries. Attempts now hold 5/10 tc records + 2 TTF records.
reflection.evidence:
- Board: 047 reg3_1000 131.154 + ksg 37.087; 050 sycamore_53 59.911; 039 surfacecode 47.824; 038 dbn 29.000; refs hold primaries, rqc, nqueens, qft.
- Composite dominates specialists: complementary mechanisms on orthogonal axes; racing arbitrates instance-dependent choices.
- Search-control globality (tempering/MCTS/acceptance) fails structurally at scale; input-level globality (simplify/seeds/cuts) keeps winning.
- Sycamore march 60.61->59.91 with shrinking variance: simplified core not exhausted.
reflection.lessons: Compose mechanisms, don't multiply search controllers. Temperature schedules are load-bearing. Tempering needs ladder density that scale forbids. VE bounded to small hypergraphs. Coarsened seeds belong inside racing.
reflection.literature: Tempering freeze-out consistent with ladder-density theory, quantified here for contraction trees; LAHC failure consistent with its plateau-vs-rugged success profile; composite architecture and the Sycamore march appear novel.
reflection.next: Cycle 10: 054 waist surgery (global FM cut of the dominant contraction), 055 diversity-maintained recombination (waist-signature floor), 056 PID-style boundary-capped block DP (Tamaki transfer; completion = certified width-constrained optimum).
